stem: What can the reader infer about Carter based on these sentences?

options.label: A
options.text: Carter sees many types of insects in his backyard all year long.

options.label: B
options.text: Carter has expanded the area that he uses to host butterflies.

options.label: C
options.text: Carter’s efforts to help butterflies have been successful.

options.label: D
options.text: Carter’s backyard is a place for citizen scientists to meet.

visual_elements: Next, he planted rows of flowering plants called milkweed—monarchs’ main source of food. (paragraph 2)
Over the past four years, Carter has raised and tagged more than 700 monarch butterflies. (paragraph 16)
